body.x: NUCODE Co., Ltd. (CEO Kwanhyeong Lee) announced its participation in CES 2025 at the K-Startup Pavilion in Las Vegas, USA, from January 7 to 10.

NUCODE supplies certified communication modules integrating the latest technologies for global markets, including Bluetooth 5.4, Wi-Fi 6, and LTE-M. The company plans to begin mass production of these modules in January 2025. These modules will be applied in diverse fields such as radar modules, solar and enclosure monitoring, smartphones for visually impaired users, smart farms, smart home gateways, and fall prevention solutions.

In the rapidly growing low-power IoT branding sector, NUCODE gained recognition within three months of its founding. It secured investment from Korea Investment Partners and won the "Promising Korean Enterprise in Telecommunications" award. It has also been selected for the TIPS (Tech Incubator Program for Startups) initiative, further enhancing its competitiveness in the IoT hardware and low-power MCU module markets.

NUCODE collaborates with TE Connectivity to develop stable communication modules and is an official partner of AVNET and Nordic. By offering advanced BLE, Thread, LTE-M, and Wi-Fi+BLE technologies globally, NUCODE lowers entry barriers for industries such as smart farming and logistics. Its adherence to international standards and certifications facilitates smooth exports to overseas markets, including the U.S.

NUCODE’s NU-Module and NU-Works are designed with low-power operation in mind, enabling software developers to implement low-power modes efficiently. These solutions simplify time-consuming processes like prototype certification, MQTT broker development, and server integration, making it easier to industrialize IoT products. The company emphasizes providing high-quality products at competitive prices through efficient manufacturing and distribution strategies, maximizing customer satisfaction.

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
